description: Type-B-folded-crystal-depth n_⋆ candidate: count of self-conjugate partitions of n = 3A (fixed points of the Kashiwara λ ↔ λ^T involution). Combinatorial probe, substrate-only (no CODATA, no operator-data needed). Result: candidate reproduces D (k=1) and T (k=2) observed closure depths from PR #638's per-eigenvalue probe, but FAILS for ³He (n_⋆ predicts k=2, ³He doesn't close at any uniform k). Same multiplicity-driven exception as PR #638; Type-B fold-depth is the (ℓ, n_0, k) piece of the open multiplicity-refined n_⋆(ℓ, n_0, k, m) candidate. Class C (diagnostic / probe) per three-calibration-discipline audit.

data.note_he3_failure: ³He fails to close at any uniform k ∈ {1..10} (per #638). Candidate Type-B fold depth = 2 (= self-conj count of partitions of 9). Failure attributed to the multiplicity profile of ³He's braid word: 8 generators with two near-pole entries (|V̂| ≈ 0.989 at positions 0 and 3) vs D/T's one each. The fold-depth candidate alone is INSENSITIVE to per-generator multiplicity asymmetry.
data.refined_open_form: n_⋆ : (ℓ, n_0, k, m) → ℕ where m = per-generator near-pole multiplicity profile. Type-B fold-depth contributes the (ℓ, n_0, k) component; m supplies the ³He correction. Same form as PR #638 refined open question.
